# Memo on Recent Developments

The Supreme Court's recent decision in *Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo* substantially altered the framework for judicial review of agency action. As Justice Roberts wrote, "Chevron is overruled" — a direct repudiation of forty years of administrative-law doctrine. See https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/23pdf/22-451_3f14.pdf.

For background, see the Westlaw treatment at https://1.next.westlaw.com/Document/I0123-FAKE-EXAMPLE/View.

A recent SSRN paper analyzes the implications: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=99999999.

The full transcript of the oral argument is available at https://this-url-does-not-exist-12345.example.com/transcript.

In a separate development, one commentator noted that "the implications for environmental regulation are profound and largely unmapped." (No source cited for this quotation.)
